answer.book: A single 1652 Zurich disputation, printed as a short work: a title page (lines 1-14) and then the Quæstio theologico-historica itself, built from numbered answers and questions, with a Corollaria section and a closing FINIS.

entries.title: Quæstio theologico-historica, an coetus ille, qui hodie, sub Episcopo Romano, tanquam Universali, eorundem sacrorum communione continetur, Ecclesiæ sanæ nomen meretur?
VII. An idem Ecclesiæ Doctor Oecumenicum agnoverit Episcopum?
